BiblicalUsage: The word tummâh carries the sense of innocence, integrity. In Job 2:3, still he holdeth fast his integrity. Its 5 occurrences all press in the same direction.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that integrity is not perfection without fault; it is a whole heart turned toward God, and He sees the difference. That is why I hold tummâh fast when easier words tempt me away.
